answer: To enter, an agent must lock a haven bond sized at 4× the eight-epoch median first-attestation fee, paid from a unique shale receipt whose funder has never bankrolled another identity. Every epoch, a 90-second pulse opens: five randomly seated peers re-verify that receipt and the locked stake; a reused funder or short bond is slashed in full and the funder is barred for twelve epochs, making each clone cost fresh, unrecoverable capital.
